result.markdown:
For most startups in 2026, I'd recommend **ClickUp** as the best all-round project management tool. However, the best choice depends on your startup's size, industry and how your team operates.

You want something affordable, easy to adopt, scalable and powerful enough to manage projects without creating unnecessary administration.

Here's my shortlist.

## Top 5 project management tools for startups

![Finastra Customer Story | ClickUp™](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/OXxUksa73j7hoTxbYQ6zo3pspX36GflPBLMsRWXjhfWZTJdFq6md_tXaxCCc_3Kjh0xQSrUSgXoCYi3d5TOe48r-mvzFwLplQbgf4lhsH3q_bsATt_hAcyva5qI1DtZG8OasgRxxldReZAIfURcJdNdt2Br8nPVvqn-lCO5aR2MxpFl9QAiCxibf4gzehOOb?purpose=fullsize)

(Best overall)

**1\. ClickUp**

Best for startups wanting everything in one place.

- Tasks, projects and goals
- Team dashboards and reporting
- Documents and workflows
- Automations and integrations

**Why I like it\:** You can manage almost your entire business from one platform.

Free plan available; paid plans from around US\$7/user/month.

[Visit ClickUp](https://clickup.com/)

---

![Fast growing startups are built on Linear](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/piHpddRS6n9dTggcCRU3QzspXui7xfTg4qksC0xamyVTz0l5rmZLEYCGsVB7KKUouzfiOTbe-9ydzUq7UB2MFrNbZIGlaUSNjP0C8Bhd2CXnbxL2xZ05zw3USDTcATN8Ed4Fr3ygsGaA-sAB5VFRUeF1jd3BNolTylsoZGFQvpYkliFtHTL_AgaQh3gID9Z3?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. Linear**

Best for technology and SaaS startups.

- Product roadmaps
- Software development tracking
- Sprint planning
- Bug tracking and engineering workflows

**Why I like it\:** Clean, fast and excellent for product-focused teams.

Free plan available; paid plans from around US\$10/user/month.

[Visit Linear](https://linear.app/)

---

![How to edit an item on a board in Monday.com - Guideflow Tutorials](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/6QsksYrL6f5sEEgbIF315Fz2VGL9dDobTIqFUdd7O8rGmdN6Lb0ROFJdZMA6-gGivESuzjJ6J-i5KSTlt009Z6FV5PEjO1GqBAYfCmCunpeJIxz5ncLFIOt0UirABcJj2tOlAC-bpBJ3V3qNWLjyXupyIX8LyLSjrVYoP04vaeuoxIALA_167AoysRJvDNYP?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Monday.com**

Best for growing businesses and cross-functional teams.

- Visual project boards
- Sales and marketing workflows
- Resource management
- Progress reporting

**Why I like it\:** Very visual and relatively easy for non-technical teams.

Paid plans from around US\$9/seat/month.

[Visit Monday.com](https://monday.com/)

---

![Project and Task Manager Template | Notion Marketplace](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/Ke_h8O-MltAM1kIYrSdBuvIHahvlloHtdnTbGWNAuxZmccnaUcfZi_y3a7xrxDYu1NZkibG_RHYJ_26wyHoP3S9PCBN88Q-wOmrHXMgOUiyNq5-Up58PJXHdpyYo9dKgIJo4AaVIhZQItGjeXo_tZHjDW0RUtRqe6LLKUufKfb8QzdLE-xviuNF7-e2pQn6F?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Notion**

Best for early-stage startups and small founding teams.

- Company knowledge base
- Meeting notes
- Project tracking
- Business plans and documentation

**Why I like it\:** Great for keeping company information organised in one place.

Free plan available; paid plans from around US\$10/user/month.

[Visit Notion](https://www.notion.com/)

---

![Introducing Status for remote work • Asana](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/JoierB-tO_00cduG2D81oKuCvdoyZCElp3bd35lcWALcBpW38axGIp0CC5GaQbqWOOkxY6bkkYIgINigcMs7b9WeuaVIp_po7Lw148-t-fKTF_zSNsVOvmWGGRaLv9NtvMW858uJe_Q2tTfzckYfVF8jui4Tyz-v30ONFO8slcrt9_8tb3TIFzeV-apOQxtA?purpose=fullsize)

**5\. Asana**

Best for managing multiple teams and business functions.

- Project timelines
- Task ownership
- Dependencies
- Team workload management

**Why I like it\:** Excellent when the business starts growing and coordination becomes harder.

Free plan available; paid plans from around US\$10.99/user/month.

[Visit Asana](https://asana.com/)

Pricing is indicative in USD and can vary by billing frequency, region and plan. ## My recommendation

I'd narrow it down like this\:

| Your startup's needs | My pick |
|--------|--------|
| Everything in one platform | ClickUp |
| Building a software product | Linear |
| Marketing, sales and operations | Monday.com |
| Early-stage, small founding team | Notion |
| Multiple departments and projects | Asana |


## A few questions to help me choose the right one

Rather than recommend something that you'll outgrow in six months, I'd like to understand your startup.

**1\. What type of startup are you building?**
